purpose: Explain the value in one idea and move the user forward.
layout: One large illustration or photo, a short headline, one sentence of support, page dots, and the continue button at the bottom with a quiet skip.

optional: Skip link in the top corner

hero.what: one illustration or one short headline that names the promise
hero.size: an illustration of 200–260px height, or a headline of 34–40px over two lines; the body copy is one short sentence

avoid: Three value props on one page

variants.layout: Large illustration top, headline, one sentence, page dots, continue button.
Full-bleed photo with the headline over a gradient at the bottom, continue button.
Headline first, then three stacked benefit rows with icons, continue button.
